units.source_text: “如果你真的缄口不言，我会马上杀了你。

en.t: If you truly keep silent, I will kill you at once.

units.source_text: ——如今你也已经不想成仙了，也厌烦了当大财主的生活。

en.t: Now you no longer want to become an immortal, and you are tired of living as a wealthy man.

units.source_text: 那么，之后你准备做什么呢？”

en.t: Then what do you intend to do from now on?
